methodology.label: 2026 public priorities
methodology.description: Ranked by the share of U.S. adults who named each issue as a government priority for 2026.
methodology.question: Thinking about the problems facing the United States and the world today, which problems would you like the government to be working on in the year 2026? Please list up to five problems.
methodology.publisher: AP-NORC Center for Public Affairs Research
methodology.tie_break: Ties follow the order of named substantive categories in the published topline; residual 'other' categories and person-specific codes are excluded.
